pages.text: An $(item)Encased Fan$() turns rotation into an air current. Items caught in it, on the ground, on a belt or a depot, get $(thing)bulk processed$() depending on what the air passes through.$(br2)Speed only changes the range, not the processing speed.

pages.title: Encased Fan
pages.text: Direction follows rotation. The air also pushes mobs, players and dropped items.

$(thing)Base types$():$(br2)$(li)Washing: air through water$(br2)$(li)Smoking: fire or campfire$(br2)$(li)Blasting: lava$(br2)$(li)Haunting: soul fire or soul campfire$(br2)Washing: $(l:create_basics/crushing)Crushing$(/l).

Blasting works like a furnace and would burn food: smoke it instead. A $(item)Blaze Burner$() also works as a blasting and smoking source, and the Lit Blaze Burner variant for haunting, see $(l:create_basics/heat)Heat$(/l).$(br2)Bars, fences and leaves let air through; solid blocks stop it.

$(thing)Added by other mods$():$(br2)$(li)Dragons Plus: ending (dragon breath), freezing (powder snow), sanding (quicksand), coloring (liquid dye), enchanting (Golden Aercloud)$(br2)$(li)Create Nuclear: enriching$(br2)$(li)Enchantment Industry: salvaging

pages.title: Enriching Campfire
pages.text: Create Nuclear's fan catalyst for bulk enriching. Enriched fire comes from Enriched Soul Soil, see $(l:industry/nuclear)Nuclear$(/l).
